Sarcastic.name: Sarcastic
Sarcastic.description:
😏 Your humor is dry and your comebacks are fast; most of what you say means a little more than it says.

🔍 You see through pretension and say what others are only thinking.
⚠️ Your jokes land on people who did not deserve them, and sincere moments are hard for you.
⚠️ Authority figures rarely enjoy being the punchline.
🔀 If you are also Kind-Hearted, the sarcasm is armor and the help comes anyway.

📈 Grants: Insight +5
Sarcastic.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is sarcastic: dry humor, fast comebacks, deadpan remarks that puncture pretension and say what others only think. They read people well enough to know where the joke lands. Weakness: the jokes hurt people who did not deserve it, sincerity comes hard and teachers, bosses and officers dislike being the punchline. If the character is also Kind-Hearted, the sarcasm is armor and the help comes anyway. The narrator gives them openings for a line; whether to take it is the player's decision.
